implementation.proof: RFC6386 signed16 first-pass wrapping, integer inverse constants, second-pass rounding and pixel saturation are unchanged. The rounded second-pass range plus byte prediction fits signed16, so packing introduces only the original final clamp. Every single-block input load precedes any output write. implementation.ownership: Borrowed spans only; no heap/cache/owner/admission change. Existing coarse workspace covers smaller stack use. Both blocks are snapshotted before the first paired write. Direct cancellation checkpoints and output independence remain.
